desc:
911 dispatcher game set in downtown Chicago. You sit at the dispatch computer, pick up calls and send police, fire trucks and ambulances where they need to go.

How it works:
1. Phone rings, you answer it
2. Ask the caller where they are and what happened
3. Put the incident in and send units
4. Watch them drive there on the map. If they need backup they radio you

Not every caller is helpful. Some panic, some hang up and some barely know where they are, so you ping their phone on the map.

A short training shift teaches the basics.

You get a grade at the end of each shift and earn money for more units and new parts of the city.

- 46 types of calls
- Real downtown Chicago streets, 14 districts to unlock
- Shifts from 2 minutes up to an hour
- Badges, a daily bonus and a global leaderboard
- Plays on PC, phone and console
- Light and dark mode

Everyone gets their own city so nobody messes with your calls. Progress saves.

Plus Subscribers get a 10% bonus at the end of shifts.
